messages:
Alex (CEO): quick Q during the Q&A — we had a handful of deals last quarter where customers cited latency and predictable cost as deciding factors. what are the concrete themes we should be surfacing to the roadmap?
Ria (VP Product): high level: customers want 1) tighter SLO defaults for hosted, 2) clearer guidance + templates for Dedicated sizing, 3) more visibility into token-level cost drivers in the console.
Meera (CS): add: requests for pre-run evals on customer prompts. they want a way to validate quality before cutover (esp for gen/rlhf-y workloads).
Tony (Sales): loss pattern I keep seeing: customers choose cloud vendor endpoints because they get a bundled infra SLA + single contract. our Dedicated pricing + rollout complexity is the friction point.
Marc (Eng Lead): tech note: latency complaints often tied to cold-starts on burst pools and suboptimal batching config. we've got changes queued but need prioritization.
Alex (CEO): action ask: can product + eng propose 3 small wins we can ship in 8 weeks that directly map to these asks? prioritise impact on wins.
Ria (VP Product): proposed 3: 1) 'SLO presets' in console (low/med/high) + quick apply; 2) Dedicated sizing wizard + recommended commit tiers; 3) pre-deploy evaluation job runner (upload prompt set, run against candidate model + report). all scoped for MVP.
Meera (CS): MVP for the eval runner should include: sample size selection, diff view of outputs, and a pass/fail regression flag. customers asked for CSV import too.
Marc (Eng Lead): notes on feasibility: SLO presets — low effort (UI + config mapping). Dedicated wizard — depends on telemetry we can expose (we need to infer expected QPS and token mix). pre-deploy eval runner — backend work + sandboxing, medium effort.
Tony (Sales): if we ship the wizard + SLO presets, I can set up a beta with 3 prospects who lost last quarter. will help convert.
Alex (CEO): timeline please.
Ria (VP Product): rough timeline: SLO presets (2 sprints), Dedicated sizing wizard (3 sprints), eval runner MVP (4-5 sprints). can compress if we allocate a small cross-functional squad.
Marc (Eng Lead): we'll need one infra engineer to unblock telemetry export and one runtime engineer for eval sandboxing.
Meera (CS): also want an internal checklist + customer-facing playbook so CSMs can run the evals. I can draft a playbook template.
Tony (Sales): request: add a short FAQ in the wizard for legal/ops concerns customers raise (data residency, encryption in transit). reduces friction.
Ria (VP Product): noted — include a security Q&A modal.
Alex (CEO): decision: form a 6-squad pilot (1 PM, 2 eng, 1 infra, 1 CS, 1 designer) and aim for first two deliverables in 8 weeks. Meera + Tony, pair on beta accounts.
Marc (Eng Lead): assigning leads: Marc -> SLO presets + runtime perf tweaks; Priya (new infra hire) -> telemetry & Dedicated wizard; Sam -> eval runner sandbox.
Meera (CS): I'll send the beta account list and a short email template for outreach.
Tony (Sales): I'll coordinate legal templates with the deals team.
DeployBot: reminder: created ticket INF-4923 for "SLO presets (console)" assigned to Marc, due 2026-05-05.
Alex (CEO): great. final ask from leadership: as you collect beta learnings, record why we won or lost — 1-2 bullet reasons per account (pricing, latency, features, process). we'll review in next all-hands.
Ria (VP Product): will do, and we'll put a lightweight schema in the project board for consistent capture.
Meera (CS): note: include "time to evaluate" as a datapoint — customers sometimes churn because evaluation took too long.
Marc (Eng Lead): one more tech FYI — enabling per-route caching may yield big wins for token cost; can ship as opt-in in the SLO preset flow.
Tony (Sales): :thumbsup: that could be the differentiator for a few deals.
Alex (CEO): thanks team. tiny ask — keep answers short in the board (one line wins/losses), we want signal not essays.
Meera (CS): got it. I'll draft the capture template today.
Ria (VP Product): I'll post the roadmap update + the beta plan in #product after this meeting.
Alex (CEO): 
Alex (CEO): closing: appreciate the focus, let's make those 8 weeks count. :rocket:
